_readme: Structured encoding of the user's discretionary swing/position strategy. 'confidence' on each rule marks how reliably it can be computed from free-tier TwelveData + Finnhub data: HARD = computed directly from price/volume, reliable. SOFT = keyword/heuristic proxy from news text, meant to prompt human review, not to fire an automatic buy/sell.

macro_gate.description: New hunting in a sector only opens once macro data has actually turned (not the rumor of it): capex guidance raised, Fed pause confirmed, money rotating into beaten-down sectors.
macro_gate.applies_to: sector-level candidacy, all stocks in a gated sector
signals_watched: Fed pause / rate-cut confirmation (FOMC statement language, not speculation)
sector capex guidance raised (from earnings calls / company guidance news)
reporting of rotation into beaten-down / out-of-favor sectors
macro_gate.output: sector_macro_status flag per sector: NEUTRAL / TURNING (soft signal seen, needs manual confirm) -- never auto-set to CONFIRMED, that judgment call is left to the user

valuation_override.description: A stock trading at a notably low valuation vs its own history or peers ('on sale') triggers reevaluation on its own, regardless of the macro gate.
valuation_override.confidence: HARD (as 52-week-range proxy) / SOFT (as true P/E-vs-history, limited by free-tier fundamentals)

primary_method.name: 52-week range position
primary_method.logic: price in bottom X% of its own trailing 52-week high/low range
primary_method.note: This is a technical cheapness proxy, not true valuation. It's always computable for free from TwelveData price history.

secondary_method.name: P/E vs own trailing history / peer sector median
secondary_method.logic: current P/E notably below its own 3yr average or below sector peer median
secondary_method.note: Free-tier fundamentals coverage varies by provider/plan -- treat this as best-effort. If unavailable, fall back to the 52-week range proxy alone and flag for manual valuation check.

candidacy_filter.description: Before a stock is even a candidate, EPS revisions must be genuinely trending up.
candidacy_filter.method: news keyword scan as a proxy for analyst EPS revisions
candidacy_filter.note: True analyst EPS revision feeds (Zacks/Refinitiv-style) are not available on Finnhub/TwelveData free tiers. This is a headline-based proxy meant to flag 'go check the actual estimate revisions', not a substitute for it.

entry_triggers.description: Entry itself is pure confirmed technicals -- never early, never on divergence alone.

golden_cross.volume_expansion_definition: volume on the cross day (or within 3 trading days after) above its own 20-day average volume

range_breakout.condition: daily close above the prior N-day range high

supply_demand_zone_reaction.zone_definition: prior price area with at least 2 touches where price stalled/reversed with elevated volume, over the trailing 90 trading days
supply_demand_zone_reaction.trigger: price re-enters a tagged demand zone and reacts (closes back above zone low within 1-3 days)

two_pole_oscillator.action: flag only -- 'watch closer', never a standalone buy trigger
two_pole_oscillator.description: Two-pole (cascaded-EMA) filtered z-score of double-detrended price. A 'buy turn' fires when it crosses above its own value from `lag` bars back while still negative; a 'sell turn' is the mirror. Carries a volatility-sized invalidation level, logged as context.

fibonacci_pullback.action: used only as an add-on-pullback zone within an already-confirmed uptrend (i.e. only relevant after an entry trigger already fired)

stop_loss.description: Stop sits at a normal distance below whichever of these is relevant to the entry, so a slightly-late confirmed entry doesn't get shaken out by noise.
stop_loss.buffer_method: ATR(14)-based buffer below the basis level

take_profit.description: Target is set purely off the stop distance so every fired entry trigger carries a fixed reward:risk ratio, computed at the moment the trigger fires.

exit_triggers.description: Exit when the reason for buying stops being true -- not just because momentum looks like it's stalling.

distribution_volume_and_trendline_break.distribution_volume_definition: down-day volume notably above its 20-day average (heavier selling than the recent norm)
distribution_volume_and_trendline_break.trendline_break: confirmed uptrend line (connecting recent swing lows) closed below

failed_supply_zone_rejection.definition: price fails to hold above a previously-reclaimed demand zone / support level and closes back below it
